title: Filming: Imagine by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono continued filming material for their feature film Imagine on 23 July 1971.

Lennon and Ono were filmed in their bedroom and on the outdoor terrace. Lennon was shown viewing through the telescope on the terrace, and opened his gown, flashing his naked body to the camera, as he returned to their table.

In the evening, following a number of interviews and photoshoots, Lennon and Ono were filmed in the Tittenhurst Park library, playing billiards with Ono’s sister Setsuko, journalist Ray Connolly, and Desiree de Freitas, the wife of political activist Michael X.

A demonstration of Ono’s ‘Ceiling Piece’ followed, with Lennon ascending a stepladder to view the word “YES” on the ceiling through a spyglass. Lennon was also filmed polishing a plexiglas cube, part of Ono’s directional piece ‘Cleaning Piece For AP’, while Ono eavesdropped at their bathroom door. That scene was filmed twice, with Ono choosing to appear topless in the second take. Lennon and Ono were then filmed taking a bath together, which marked the end of the day’s shoot.

This was the final day of filming in England; from 5 September more footage was shot in New York City.
